qualification.details: RJP-051: PhD in Botany/Bioinformatics/Biotechnology/Biochemistry. Expertise required in field of Bioinformatics OR Microbiology specially in field of cyanobacteria of algae. RJP-052: PhD in Plant Biology/Botany/Plant Science/Plant Biotechnology/Plant Molecular Biology/Genetics/Life Sciences or a closely related discipline. Experience of having worked with plants (Arabidopsis, potato or tomato), Plant tissue culture, Plant transformation and molecular biology techniques. RJP-053: PhD in Botany/Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Plant Science/Bioscience/Plant Biotechnology/Plant Molecular Biology/Biochemistry or a closely related discipline. Experience in plant tissue culture, Plant transformation, molecular biology (Gene cloning, protein-protein/DNA interactions, protein expressions and purification, Co-IP and CRISPR/Cas system) Microscopy, Data analysis and Bioinformatics. RJP-054: PhD in Biochemistry/Biotechnology/Microbiology/Life Sciences/Zoology. Preference will be given to the candidates having research experience in the field of Molecular Biology, recombinant protein expression/purification/characterization, bacteriophage isolation their characterization with evidence of original research publications. RJP-055: PhD in Life Science/Bioinformatics/Zoology/Biomedical Science/Biotechnology or any relevant field. Expertise in Cancer Biology specially Leukaemia, Mammalian cell culture (Preferably suspension culture) and Related molecular biology techniques including Gene Knockdown/knockout experiments, Time/Dose assays for prospective drugs, Cell viability/Cytotoxicity assays. RJP-056: PhD Degree in Biotechnology/Cell Biology/Applied Microbiology/Life Sciences/Zoology/Botany/Bioscience/Molecular Biology/Biochemistry/Bioinformatics/Forensic Science. Expertise in Cancer Biology, mammalian cell culture and cell line maintenance, molecular and biochemical biology techniques, and cell-based functional assays. RJP-057: PhD in Chemical Sciences. Experience in heterogeneous catalysis, CO2 hydrogenation, catalytic reactors. RJP-058: PhD Degree (preferably awarded) in Atmospheric/Environmental Science, Environmental Science & Technology, Chemistry, Environmental Technology, Forensic Science, Meteorology, Civil/Environmental Engineering, Atmospheric Sciences, Geochemistry, Environmental Chemistry, Green chemistry or in any allied science discipline. Experience in air pollution monitoring, instrumentation, data handling and analysis, Environmental modeling (including PCA, EPA, WRF etc). RJP-059: PhD in Organic Chemistry. Experience in Electro-catalysis/Photo-Catalysis/Transition Metal-Catalysis for Organic Synthesis. RJP-060: PhD in (Geology/Applied Geology/Earth Science related areas). Prior experience in the field of Metamorphic Petrology or related field will be preferred. RJP-061: PhD degree in Physics. Experience in experimental soft condensed matter Physics, Experience in Simulations, Preferred with Programming skills. RJP-062: PhD in Theoretical Nuclear Physics or Experimental Nuclear Physics. Strong background in Theoretical Nuclear Physics, Nuclear Shell Model Calculations and Allowed and Forbidden Beta Decay studies. Experience with computational nuclear physics and scientific programming will be an added advantage. RJP-063: PhD in Physics. Experience of using Quantum Chemistry Software, Experience of research in Astrochemistry, Programming skills and knowledge of Machine Learning. RJP-064: PhD in Physics. Expertise in synthesis of Quantum Dots through facile techniques (hydrothermal and sol-gel method and 2D-Nanomaterials through CVD techniques), characterization of nanomaterials through XRD, SEM, TEM, PL, UV-Vis, Raman Spectroscopy, AFM etc., Thin-Film Deposition, Fabrication of photodetectors based on QDs and 2D nanomaterials. RJP-065: PhD in Physics. Experimental and/or Computational skill in plasma physics, space physics, materials for extreme environments, atomic physics. RJP-066: PhD in Physics. Prior experience of using MD simulation on soft matter, good at computational/numerical and analytical methods. RJP-067: PhD in a Geography/Environmental Sciences/Geoinformatics/Climate Science/Atmospheric Science. Experience in GNSS meterology, atmospheric water vapour studies, climate and hydrological data analysis, GIS and remote sensing, programming (Python/R/MATLAB etc.) statistical modelling, and handling of reanalysis and satellite datasets. Familiarity with machine learning and AI applications in atmospheric and climate sciences. RJP-068: M.Sc. in Environmental Science/Botany/Plant Biotechnology with 55% marks along with Ph.D. degree in Environmental Science/Botany/Plant Biotechnology. Research experience in the field plant-microbe interactions, proteomics, reverine ecosystem, plant ecotoxicological response, recycling of organic waste in agriculture. RJP-069: PhD degree in Agricultural Sciences/Geography/Environmental Science/Electronics/Computer Science/Environmental Science & Technology/Geoinformatics/Physics/Civil Engineering. Prior Research experience in remote sensing data handling. RJP-070: PhD in Environmental Science/Chemistry/Statistics. Having experience in water and waste water analysis/handling of large data sets. RJP-071: PhD in (Life Science/Biotechnology/Microbiology/Environmental Science/Plant Science or any related field). Research experience in the field of plant-microbe-soil interaction, phytomicrobiome, Soil Microbiology, sustainable agriculture, Bioinformatics, Molecular biology, Microbial screening and Metabolite extraction upscaling and its purifications. RJP-072: Ph.D. degree in Mathematics. Experience in Harmonic Analysis, Microlocal Analysis, Integral Transforms and Wavelet Theory. Experience in the study of wavefronts sets, distribution theory and partial differential equations, strong analytical, communication and scientific writing skills. RJP-073: MSc & PhD in Microbiology/Botany/Biotechnology/Zoology/Applied Microbiology. Experience and publications in the fields of Bacteriology, Antimicrobial Resistance, Bacterial biofilm, drug interventions and hands on experience in proteomics and related molecular tools. RJP-074: PhD in Economics/Geography/Statistics. Demonstrated research experience in development-related issues, including health, poverty, nutrition, inequality, labour, and other social sector issues. Strong proficiency in statistical and econometric analysis using software such as STATA, R, Python, etc. Proven hands-on experience in analysing large-scale national survey datasets, including NFHS, NSS, IHDS, LASI, PLFS. RJP-075: PhD Biochemistry/Biotechnology/Bioinformatics. Wet lab experience of DNA/RNA isolation, human cancer tissue handling/human cancer research, PCR, section cutting staining and IHC. RJP-076: PhD in Zoology, Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Neuroscience and Animal Biotechnology. Strong background in molecular biology, mammalian cell culture, basic endocrinology, reproductive biology and animal handling. RJP-077: PhD in Zoology/Life Sciences. Prior hand on experience in the relevant area of Molecular Biology/Bioinformatics/Animal Handling relevant to Zoology fields will be preferred. RJP-078: PhD in Life Sciences/Zoology/Biochemistry/Biotechnology or allied areas. Candidates with experience in Drosophila genetics or mouse models, stem cells or tumour biology and metabolic research will be preferred. RJP-079: PhD in Zoology/Biochemistry/Neuroscience with a background in Neuroendocrinology/Metabolism/Biochemistry. Strong background in Molecular biology, Metabolism, Developmental Neurobiology and Basic endocrinology and Expertise in animal handling is a must. Candidate with expertise in neuron and astrocyte culture will be preferred. RJP-080: PhD in Zoology/Biochemistry/Animal Biotechnology/Biosciences/Immunology/Developmental Biology. Strong Background in Molecular Biology, Immunology and immunological assays, Cell culture (primary and cell-line) and basic endocrinology. Candidate with bone biology and immunology will be preferred. RJP-081: PhD in Mathematics/Physics. Candidates must have research experience in the field of Cosmology. RJP-019: PhD with First Class Post Graduate Degree in Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Bioinformatics/Zoology from a recognized Institute/University. Experience in handling advanced molecular biology techniques and laboratory instruments, including Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS), CGH Array, and Sanger sequencing, Experience in bioinformatics, multi-omics data analysis, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulation, virtual screening, in silico drug discovery and target prediction, structural bioinformatics, protein-ligand interaction analysis, scientific writing, and project report preparation.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Banaras Hindu University (BHU). BHU is a prestigious central university located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, known for its academic excellence and research contributions across various disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for BHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellow. These positions are designed for researchers who have recently completed their Ph.D. and wish to pursue advanced research.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BHU Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellow posts is 21 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the university by this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for these posts is Offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it along with the required documents to the specified address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellow at BHU?
faq.answer: The salary for Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellow posts ranges from Rs. 60000 to Rs. 70000 per month, along with HRA as applicable. This competitive salary package is offered to attract top research talent.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for BHU Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellow?
faq.answer: The primary qualification required is a Ph.D. in a relevant discipline. Specific qualifications and experience vary for each post, covering diverse fields like Biotechnology, Physics, Environmental Science, and more.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for BHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the BHU Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellow Recruitment 2026. This makes it accessible for all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellow posts primarily involves Application Screening. Further details regarding interviews or other stages will be communicated to shortlisted candidates.

faq.answer: The job location for the Raja Jwala Prasad Post-Doctoral Fellow posts is Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, specifically at Banaras Hindu University. Varanasi is a culturally rich city offering a vibrant academic environment.
